findings.detail: The raw SOI rows show the flagged spreads and interest rates as printed, so the nonzero agentA_spread_vs_xbrl residual is on the XBRL reconciliation side rather than the source schedule terms.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The filing rows for the six flagged instruments print the same reference-rate spread, interest rate, maturity, and asset type carried in the Agent A identifiers: Heights Buyer rows at S + 5.75% / 9.50% and S + 5.00% / 8.75%, KENE at S + 4.75% / 8.40%, and Monarch at S + 4.50% / 8.15%. Because raw source confirms the schedule-term side while the flag reports nonzero agentA_spread_vs_xbrl residuals, the error is localized to extraction/reconciliation of the XBRL side, not a false alarm.
